children.label: self_attn
children.op_formula_derived:
q_a_proj = linear(x)
q_a_layernorm = rmsnorm(q_a_proj)
q_b_proj = linear(q_a_layernorm)
q_split_heads = head_split(q_b_proj)
q_nope_slice = slice(q_split_heads)
q_pe_slice = slice(q_split_heads)
q_pe_rope = rope(q_pe_slice)
query_concat = concat(q_nope_slice, q_pe_rope)
kv_a_proj_with_mqa = linear(x)
kv_latent_slice = slice(kv_a_proj_with_mqa)
kv_a_layernorm = rmsnorm(kv_latent_slice)
kv_b_proj = linear(kv_a_layernorm)
kv_split_heads = head_split(kv_b_proj)
k_nope_slice = slice(kv_split_heads)
k_pe_slice = slice(kv_a_proj_with_mqa)
k_pe_rope = rope_emb(k_pe_slice)
k_pe_split = head_broadcast(k_pe_rope)
k_split_heads = concat(k_nope_slice, k_pe_split)
qk_score = attention_score(query_concat, k_split_heads)
softmax = softmax(qk_score)
value_slice = slice(kv_split_heads)
attn_apply = attention_apply(softmax, value_slice)
o_merge_heads = head_merge(attn_apply)
o_proj = linear(o_merge_heads)

Exact product: the split axis's extent must equal outer · inner — drop a ragged tail with an explicit upstream `slice` (as DSv4's compressor slices to `(s_ctx // m) · m` complete windows) rather than rounding here.
